Rene: Heads-up 7: Helix ran a pricing experiment and a promo cap bug overrode limits for a set of pilot customers in Apr. They want retro credits.
Aiko: How many accounts and rough $ impact?
Rene: Helix reports 9 accounts, $3,240 total after proration. Pasted sample: `inv-5551,ProtoCo,2025-04,$900,$540,$360`.
Marcus: Ops: smaller than $5k so finance lead can approve. Do we do direct refunds or partner-level credit? Helix prefers credit memo.
Tina: Approved. Post consolidated credit memo to Helix for $3,240. GL: `GL-EXPERIMENT-ADJ`. Memo: "Helix pricing-experiment corrective credit Apr 2025".
